description: This file defines the internal class ActivationCollector responsible for managing grain activations, including scheduling, collecting, deactivating, and memory pressure handling within the Orleans runtime. It implements interfaces for lifecycle participation and working set observation, and contains methods for activation lifecycle management, memory-based deactivation, and logging.

classes.name: ActivationCollector
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and collection of grain activations, including scheduling, deactivation, and memory pressure response.

classes.name: ActivationCollector.Bucket
classes.description: A helper class representing a collection of activations grouped by their collection ticket.

classes.name: ActivationCollector.ActivationsLogValue
classes.description: A struct used for logging a list of activations.

methods.name: GetNumRecentlyUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of activations used recently within a specified recency period.

methods.name: CollectActivations
methods.description: Initiates collection of activations idle for at least the specified age limit.

methods.name: ScheduleCollection
methods.description: Schedules a specific grain context for collection after a given timeout.

methods.name: TryCancelCollection
methods.description: Attempts to cancel scheduled collection for a grain context.

methods.name: TryRescheduleCollection
methods.description: Attempts to reschedule collection for a grain context.

methods.name: DequeueQuantum
methods.description: Removes and returns activations due for collection based on quantum timing.

methods.name: ScanStale
methods.description: Scans for activations that are stale and due for collection.

methods.name: ScanAll
methods.description: Scans all buckets for activations idle beyond a specified age limit.

methods.name: IsMemoryOverloaded
methods.description: Checks if the environment is under memory pressure and calculates surplus activations to deactivate.

methods.name: DeactivateInDueTimeOrder
methods.description: Deactivates a specified number of activations in order of their due time.

methods.name: MakeTicketFromDateTime
methods.description: Creates a collection ticket from a specific DateTime, rounded to the collection quantum.

methods.name: MakeTicketFromTimeSpan
methods.description: Creates a collection ticket from a timeout span relative to now.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a grain activation to the appropriate bucket with a specified collection ticket.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the activation collection and memory deactivation loops.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the collection and deactivation loops gracefully.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes timers and cancellation tokens used by the collector.
